data.revised_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS app icon for a voice memo queue classifier named Queue Populator. Primary request: a polished vector-friendly icon, centered microphone capsule merged with a subtle ordered queue/list motif, modern macOS rounded-square composition, dark graphite background, warm amber/orange voice core, lime accent line, crisp dimensional lighting, no words, no letters, no watermark, no UI screenshot, simple silhouette readable at 16px.
